about_short_description.short_description: Shasta Health is a physical therapy center that offers patient acquisition, billing, care plans, and other care facilities.

product.name: In-Home Physical Therapy
product.description: Physical therapy services delivered at patients' homes, covered by insurance with low co-pays, providing personalized one-on-one care without the need for clinic visits.

product.name: Virtual Physical Therapy
product.description: Remote physical therapy sessions conducted via video calls, enabling patients to receive professional guidance and treatment from home.

product.name: Personalized Physical Therapy Treatment Plans
product.description: Customized therapy programs developed by licensed physical therapists based on individual patient evaluations, conditions, and goals.

product.name: Insurance Navigation and Billing Support
product.description: Assistance with insurance verification, claims submission, and billing to maximize patient benefits and minimize out-of-pocket costs.

product.name: Specialized Physical Therapy Programs
product.description: Targeted therapy services focusing on specific conditions such as back pain, scoliosis, knee arthritis, vestibular rehabilitation, and injury prevention.
